//: Type-aware lint project for tooling/ and the eslint fixtures. ESLint's projectService consumes this. pnpm typecheck runs tsc over tsconfig.typecheck.json, which extends this but leaves out eslint-fixtures, so their intentional violations never fail the build, and over tsconfig.node.json for the scripts node runs itself. A .mjs script added here is checked and linted like the rest; the perf payloads (perf/*.js) have their own DOM-only project.
